# API Tokens JavaScript API

Everything the [API Tokens](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/api-tokens) extension adds to `pb_hooks` and page code, generated from the TypeScript declarations it ships (your app's `types.d.ts` has the same, so your editor knows them). For how to use it, see its docs; for Go, the [Go API](https://pocketone.dev/docs/reference/go).

## $apiTokens

API token scopes.

```js
$apiTokens.registerScope({ name: "notes:write", description: "Change notes", paths: ["/api/collections/notes/records"] })
routerAdd("POST", "/api/notes/archive", (e) => { ... }, $apis.requireAuth(), $apiTokens.requireScope("notes:write"))
```

### $apiTokens.registerScope()

```ts
$apiTokens.registerScope(def: tokens.ScopeDef): void
```

Registers a scope (top level of a pb_hooks file); the same name again merges.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `def` | `tokens.ScopeDef` |  |

### $apiTokens.requireScope()

```ts
$apiTokens.requireScope(name: string): any
```

Route middleware: a token, if the request uses one, must hold the scope.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |  |

Returns `any`.

### $apiTokens.hasScope()

```ts
$apiTokens.hasScope(e: core.RequestEvent, name: string, value?: string): boolean
```

Whether the request may use the scope (always true without a token). With a value: whether it may use the scope
on that value (it holds the bare scope, or "name=value").

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `e` | `core.RequestEvent` |  |
| `name` | `string` |  |
| `value` | `string` (optional) |  |

Returns `boolean`.

### $apiTokens.scopeValues()

```ts
$apiTokens.scopeValues(e: core.RequestEvent, name: string): { all: boolean; values: string[] }
```

The values the request holds the scope for: all is true for every value.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `e` | `core.RequestEvent` |  |
| `name` | `string` |  |

Returns `{ all: boolean; values: string[] }`.

### $apiTokens.ruleField()

```ts
$apiTokens.ruleField(name: string): string
```

The collection-rule field for the scope.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |  |

Returns `string`.

### $apiTokens.scopes()

```ts
$apiTokens.scopes(): tokens.Scope[]
```

Every registered scope.

Returns `tokens.Scope[]`.

## Types

### tokens.ScopeDef

A scope API tokens and OAuth clients can be granted.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | e.g. "notes:read". |
| `description?` | `string` |  |
| `paths?` | `string[]` | Path prefixes the scope covers. |
| `methods?` | `string[]` | HTTP methods it covers (all when empty). |
| `collections?` | `string[]` | Collections whose record APIs it covers. |
| `values?` | `{ description: string }` | Lets a token hold the scope for some values only, written "name=value" (e.g. "notes=abc123"); the bare name still means every value. Routes check the value with hasScope(e, name, value). |

### tokens.Scope

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `header` | `string` | The request header a token's scope shows up in. |
| `ruleField` | `string` | The field to use in collection rules, e.g. "@request.headers.x_token_scope_notes_read". |
